Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery exists because the hard part of this work is not the model — it is the measurement, the ownership and the audit trail. That is what this page describes.

blocks.title: Zero-trust verification mesh — Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery
blocks.note: Lateral movement dies here: workload identity and micro-segmentation mean one compromised node is one node, not the estate.

blocks.x: The architecture for Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery is deliberately auditable: every stage exposes its inputs, its owner and its failure policy, and the decision path shares a timeline with the audit path. Nothing important happens off the record.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
